mapper.select: SELECT C.OrderNo AS orderNo, C.OrderProdNo AS seq, IFNULL(OP.ProdName, '') AS prodName, IFNULL(OP.ItemName, '') AS itemName, OP.ProdQty AS orderQty, C.MatchProdCode AS code, C.TotalQty AS totalQty, U.UseYn AS upriceUseYn, U.OrderProdName AS upriceName FROM shopwizard.tOrdCurrOrderProd C INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = C.OrderNo AND OP.OrderProdNo = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tOrdOrderUprice U ON U.MatchUpriceCode = C.MatchProdCode ORDER BY C.OrderNo, C.OrderProdNo
SELECT ProdName AS prodName, ItemName AS itemName, MatchSeq AS matchSeq, MatchUpriceCode AS code, Qty AS qty FROM shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch ORDER BY ProdName, ItemName, MatchSeq

SELECT M.ChnlName AS chnlName, LEFT(M.ProdName, 80) AS prodName, LEFT(IFNULL(M.PrevProdOption, ''), 60) AS prevOption, M.OrderNo AS orderNo FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderUpriceMatch M WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopwizard.tOrdCurrOrderProd C WHERE C.OrderNo = M.OrderNo) ORDER BY M.RegistDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tOrdUpriceMatch WHERE ProdName = #{prodName} AND ItemName = #{itemName}
